games.name: Star Wars Tycoon ✨
games.desc:
Welcome to Star Wars Tycoon!

Immerse yourself in the thrilling galaxy of Star Wars Tycoon, where you can step into the role of your favorite Star Wars character and embark on an intergalactic adventure. Choose from a range of iconic characters and bring your Star Wars fantasies to life.

Build and upgrade your tycoon to unlock powerful abilities and legendary weapons. Fortify your base, gather resources, and prepare for epic battles against other players. Outmaneuver your opponents, defend your territory, and climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Join our group and start with an extra $2,500 in credits! This bonus will give you a head start in creating the most formidable tycoon in the galaxy. Join the group here: https://www.roblox.com/groups/35139501/Anhelation#!/about

We're constantly working on new and exciting content, so be on the lookout for upcoming game updates and events. Expect plenty of surprises to keep you on the edge of your seat.
